consequence.statement: Environments relying on the default now get Hubble auto-generated certificates valid for 365 days instead of 1095 days.

assertion.statement: The default of Helm value hubble.tls.auto.certValidityDuration was lowered from 1095 to 365 days, so auto-generated Hubble TLS certificates get a shorter validity unless the value is set explicitly.
